description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kadyn Proctor is still not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Proctor has not been able to practice through concussion protocol.
items.title: Kadyn Proctor (concussion) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: JuJu Brents returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brents was wearing a red, no-contact jersey as he advances in concussion protocol.
items.title: JuJu Brents (neck/concussion) back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Keisean Nixon is now listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Nixon was a late addition to the injury report. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
items.title: Keisean Nixon (shoulder) now questionable Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tony Pollard was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reasoning is for Pollard's absence. He'll need to be monitored on the injury report.
items.title: Tony Pollard not seen practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lamar Jackson practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson remains on track to return for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins returned to practice on Thursday.

items.desc: Matthew Golden is "trending toward playing" in Week 8 against the Panthers.

items.desc: Derwin James had a setback in his return from a hamstring injury.

items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) suffers setback

items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. was a full participant in practice on Thursday.

items.desc: Emeka Egbuka was not wearing his non-contact jersey for Thursday's practice.
